subject: financial_literacy
concept: Building a simple monthly budget by subtracting expenses from income
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student uses physical income and expense tiles to build a simple budget and calculate what's left over
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a set of income/expenses to its correctly calculated leftover amount
exercise.abstract: Student builds a simple budget for a given income and set of expenses

misconception_flags: forgets to include one of the given expenses when calculating the total

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
